clips.name: LampshadeIdle
clips.authored_posture: persistent C-curve, withdrawn neck, bent knees
clips.gait: weary asymmetric weight shift

clips.name: LampshadeWalk
clips.authored_posture: persistent C-curve, withdrawn neck, bent knees
clips.gait: short uneven steps, heavy left boot and quick right recovery

clips.name: ChairCarrierIdle
clips.authored_posture: upright load-balanced spine, hands fixed on shoulder loops
clips.gait: small precise weight correction under chair load

clips.name: ChairCarrierWalk
clips.authored_posture: upright load-balanced spine, hands fixed on shoulder loops
clips.gait: high-knee precise heel-led steps with minimal arm swing

clips.name: KettleHatIdle
clips.authored_posture: low stout stance, belly forward, head sunk under the kettle
clips.gait: slow settling weight roll with counter-phased belly and kettle

clips.name: KettleHatWalk
clips.authored_posture: low stout stance, belly forward, head sunk under the kettle
clips.gait: fast short steps with a constant waddle and counter-phased kettle

clips.name: LongArmIdle
clips.authored_posture: narrow still body, raised shoulders, arms hanging to the ankles
clips.gait: dead-still torso under a slow residual arm sway that never settles

clips.name: LongArmWalk
clips.authored_posture: narrow still body, raised shoulders, arms hanging to the ankles
clips.gait: slow shuffle with barely lifted feet and a lagging pendulum swing

clips.name: LampshadeSit
clips.authored_posture: seated C-curve, shade tipped forward over folded knees
clips.gait: settled seated breath that never straightens the spine

clips.name: ChairCarrierSit
clips.authored_posture: upright seated spine, the inverted chair still shouldered
clips.gait: small seated correction that keeps the chair balanced

clips.name: KettleHatSit
clips.authored_posture: stout seated stance, short legs hanging clear of the floor
clips.gait: counter-phased belly and kettle sway with the legs at rest

clips.name: LongArmSit
clips.authored_posture: narrow seated torso, long forearms folded onto the knees
clips.gait: residual arm sway that never settles, now over the knees

clips.name: HelmetLampIdle
clips.authored_posture: coiled crouch on both hind feet, forearms tucked like forepaws
clips.gait: settled twitching crouch while the helmet beam sweeps side to side

clips.name: HelmetLampHop
clips.authored_posture: coiled crouch on both hind feet, forearms tucked like forepaws
clips.gait: two-footed rabbit hop: crouch, launch, tucked airborne apex, landing

clips.name: PipebackIdle
clips.authored_posture: self-propelled seated posture, feet planted on twin footrests
clips.gait: still head over a slow breath that pumps bellows under the pipe load

clips.name: PipebackRoll
clips.authored_posture: self-propelled seated posture, hands following both raised push levers
clips.gait: two-handed lever push, release and recovery under a swaying pipe load

clips.name: BabushkaSmoke
clips.authored_posture: hunched strolling stance, cigarette held ready in the right hand
clips.gait: four shuffling steps under emphatic left-arm talk, one drag per lap

clips.name: BabushkaBeat
clips.authored_posture: hunched working stance squared to the hung carpet
clips.gait: overhead wind-up, sharp forward beater strike and a rocking recovery

clips.name: WeigherCheck
clips.authored_posture: planted stance beside the mechanism, chalk ready in the right hand
clips.gait: look up at the dial, lean in to the linkage, crouch to chalk the deck edge

clips.name: WeighedPace
clips.authored_posture: burdened walk down the deck axis with free hands
clips.gait: shuffling steps, a square standstill at centre while the scale settles, steps resume

clips.name: MournerWalk
clips.authored_posture: bowed mourning stance, both hands cradling the bouquet at the chest
clips.gait: short heavy grieving steps with no arm swing

clips.name: MournerMourn
clips.authored_posture: graveside grief from a standing bow
clips.gait: lay the bouquet low, thirty seconds of shoulder-shaking sobs behind raised hands, wipe each eye and straighten

clips.name: WatchmanWatch
clips.authored_posture: rounded old shoulders, chin up under the cap, hands clasped behind the back
clips.gait: slow weight transfers, a disapproving head shake and one smug chin jut with a shrug

clips.name: WatchmanShuffle
clips.authored_posture: rounded old shoulders, chin up under the cap, hands clasped behind the back
clips.gait: short heavy shuffling steps with no arm swing and a mild capped-head bob

clips.name: FishermanLean
clips.authored_posture: tipped forward over the end board, weight on the front foot, both hands on the rod
clips.gait: four slow breaths under the hood, one rod correction and a look down the line

clips.name: FishermanTrudge
clips.authored_posture: hooded oilskin stance with the rod carried forward in both hands
clips.gait: short heavy steps in waders with almost no arm swing

clips.name: ChessBrood
clips.authored_posture: perched on the bench plank, both elbows on the board rim, the head sunk into both hands
clips.gait: three slow breaths carried by the ribs alone and one deeper settle

clips.name: ChessTrudge
clips.authored_posture: stooped old stance with both hands buried in the overcoat pockets
clips.gait: short flat park steps with the shoulders carried ahead of the hips

clips.name: ChessJeer
clips.authored_posture: perched on the plank, right elbow still on the board rim, left arm thrown up across the set
clips.gait: head turned out from under the hands to the neighbour, a hard left-arm throw, the accusation held, and a collapse back into the palms slower than the throw was

clips.name: CheckersMull
clips.authored_posture: perched on the bench plank, both elbows on the board rim, the head sunk into both hands
clips.gait: three shallow breaths carried by the ribs alone and one early settle

clips.name: CheckersTrudge
clips.authored_posture: stooped old stance with both hands buried in the overcoat pockets
clips.gait: short flat park steps with the shoulders carried ahead of the hips

clips.name: CheckersJeer
clips.authored_posture: perched on the plank, right elbow still on the board rim, left arm thrown up back across the set
clips.gait: head turned out from under the hands to the neighbour, a hard left-arm throw, the accusation held, and a collapse back into the palms slower than the throw was
